items.rationale: Like-for-like fittings for the covered heating-pipe repair fall under §§2.4.3 and 7.1.7(c): 4 × €14.
Section 7.1.7(c) covers matching fittings, but §7.1.8(e) excludes dimensions not attributable to the documented repair. The 28 mm connection is not confirmed; if substantiated, 5 × €24.
Section 7.1.8(e) requires the 28 mm fitting to match the repaired installation, which is not confirmed. If substantiated, 1 × €25 under §7.1.7(c).
Minor repair fasteners are covered under §7.1.7(c): 8 × €2.
Repair supports are covered under §7.1.7(c) if used on the repaired installation; §7.1.8(e) excludes unrelated hardware. The conditional estimate is 4 × €8.
The failed indoor heating pipe is covered under §2.4.3(a), with like-for-like replacement under §7.1.7(c): 6.4 invoiced metres × €22.
Necessary trade labour is covered under §7.1.7(g). At the full-cover prior, 6.75 hours × about €84 gives approximately €566.
Necessary helper labour is covered under §7.1.7(g). The prior for the full 5.75 invoiced hours is €394.
Section 7.1.7(c) covers restoration of the existing insulation on the repaired pipe. The six-piece gross prior is €146.
Insulation fastening wire is a covered installation consumable under §7.1.7(c): 2 kg × €10.
Section 7.1.7(c) permits a lump sum for minor repair consumables, provided it does not duplicate itemised charges under §7.1.8(c). The estimate is 1 × €25.
Section 7.1.7(f) allows the first travel charge per contractor per invoice. This is the only one billed: 1 × €80.
Disposal of material removed in the covered repair falls under §§5.2.1 and 7.1.7(a), but unrelated flooring waste does not. The conditional estimate is one disposal charge at €62.
Sections 3.5 and 7.1.5 exclude repainting the unaffected hallway. The conditional price is 12 m² × €18.
The storage-room floor was undamaged and separate from the affected plant room, so §§7.1.5–7.1.6 do not cover it. The conditional price is 15 m² × €75.
Section 7.1.8(a) excludes unrelated tap maintenance. The conditional price is one service at €110.
Section 7.1.8(b) expressly excludes separately billed processing fees. The conditional price is one fee at €25.
